senses.gloss:
√kāṅkṣ 'desire'
present: [1.] kāṅkṣati kāṅkṣate etc. B.+ 
perfect: cakāṅkṣa E.+ 
[aorist: acakāṅkṣat akāṅkṣīt kāṅkṣiṣyati kāṅkṣitā ]
verbal: kāṅkṣita E.+ 
secondary: intensive: cākāṅkṣya- -- desiderative: cikāṅkṣiṣa- -- causative: kāṅkṣayate E.+ 
derivatives: -kāṅkṣa kāṅkṣā E.+ kāṅkṣin E.+ -kāṅkṣya C. -kāṅkṣaṇa C. kāṅkṣaṇīya C. -kāṅkṣitavya C. 
Perhaps a desiderative formation from √kan or kam.
